grader.scenario: Multi-SIM Family Share plan not allocating 25GB shared data allowance from lead SIM to daughter's secondary SIM
grader.notes: Exemplary 11/11 PASS call. Patrick verifies Wojciech's address, PIN, and security question at [03:38] (around 03:40, just inside the 240s threshold), manages a 105s hold cleanly ([06:57]-[08:52]), checks the daughter's handset balance display before ([05:58]) and after ([10:20]) re-binding the shared data bucket, and proactively fixes the third family SIM ([06:36]).

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: [00:00] Patrick opens with 'thank you for calling S-Net' and closes at [14:35] with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net'.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: [06:57]-[08:52] Single 105-second managed hold announced with 'Please bear with me while I re-bind the donor and member MSISDNs...' and returned with 'Thank you so much for holding, Wojciech'.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: [03:38]-[03:45] Patrick verifies Wojciech's billing address, four-digit account PIN, and memorable security question at [03:38] (just inside the 240-second verification window).

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: [00:22] Patrick addresses Wojciech by name warmly and naturally throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:22], [00:54] Patrick apologizes sincerely and validates Wojciech's worry about his daughter Zuzanna running out of data while on a university field trip in the Peak District.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [01:10] Patrick clearly paraphrases the issue: Wojciech holds the 100GB lead Family Share plan and assigned a 25GB slice to Zuzanna's linked secondary SIM, but her handset is acting as if it has zero high-speed data.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [02:28]-[02:55], [05:58]-[06:36], [10:10]-[10:34] Patrick tracks every detail Wojciech shares (daughter Zuzanna on iPhone 14 in Castleton, line 4409, Sunday upgrade to 100GB, wife's line 7731) and checks the exact app balance displayed on Zuzanna's handset both before ([05:58]) and after ([10:20]) re-syncing the shared bucket.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [01:42], [05:22], [06:36]-[08:52] Patrick takes full ownership of diagnosing the orphaned bucket ID (`SB-99402-A` vs `SB-99402-B`), re-binding both secondary SIMs (4409 and 7731), clearing the 64kbps QoS restriction, and setting 80% usage alerts.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [00:22]-[14:35] Patrick builds warm rapport, asks about Zuzanna's Peak District geography trip, and proactively checks the third family SIM (7731).

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: [02:01]-[02:55] Patrick asks targeted diagnostic questions about the Family Data Manager slider status, when the 25GB change was made relative to the tariff upgrade, and Zuzanna's handset/connectivity.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [09:31]-[11:02] Wojciech confirms his app shows Pool SB-99402-B linked, and Zuzanna confirms via screenshot that her iPhone 14 now shows '25.0 GB remaining (from Wojciech)' and uploads a 40MB GIS survey file in 3 seconds over 5G.
